4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Graded this week: your Block Breaker published with a working link turned in on Google Classroom, one new software pattern added (the Singleton pattern: one GameState object that holds score and lives), and a 3-sentence explanation of what it is, why we used it, and how it improves your game.
4th Period.workingNow: Open the Google Classroom assignment called Singleton Pattern. Read the instructions, follow them, then fill out the exit ticket when you are done.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can explain in one sentence what a Singleton is and add a GameState object holding score and lives that shows on my game screen.

agenda: Mini-lesson: one backpack, not papers everywhere (8 min)
We do: plan GameState together (7 min)
You do: add GameState with Copilot, show it on screen (20 min)
